sourceWorkbook: RCCC catalog 2026–27 (program 35130 and course pages), Self-Service course schedule Fall 2026 – Summer 2027, 2026–27 academic calendar, NCAEC apprenticeship handbook — compiled 2026-10-20

courses.title: DC/AC Electricity
courses.description: Direct- and alternating-current theory: units, circuit laws, series and parallel circuits, magnetism, transformers, measurement with meters. Co-requisite with ELC 126 in the first fall.
